---
title: "xuepoch"
---

## Description

Derive EPOCH variable using SE SDTM dataset.

## Parameters

**`inds`**

: Name of the input dataset

  *Required:* Yes

**`dtcdate`**

: Name of the date variable

  *Required:* Yes

**`outds`**

: Name of the output dataset

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `&inds`

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xuepoch(lb,lbdtc);
```
